clips.title: The story
paras: Carolai Anise is an eccentric Forsaken alchemist residing in the village of Brill in Tirisfal Glades. She trains novice alchemists, though her hazardous concoctions have drawn nervous murmurs from local guards.

Operating out of Brill, Carolai Anise devotes her unlife to the volatile art of alchemy. While many Forsaken researchers operate under the Royal Apothecary Society's grim mandate, Carolai pursues her own strange brews right inside the settlement. Her unpredictable experiments and smoking retorts are notorious enough that the Deathguards keeping watch over Brill openly grumble that she seems bent on blowing up her own house.
